pairs.why: Both palms share the real cards' soft, slightly glossy finish; B's tidier trunk and the scattered pebbles at its base are a little closer to the clean, readable props on the real cards.
The two are almost identical; A has the same slightly cleaner trunk and pebble base that I picked in q016, so I kept the choice consistent.
Both parrots render like the real cards; A's open, smiling beak gives it the friendly character the lessons rewarded (like the smiling cat), and its feathers are just as smooth.
Close to a coin flip; B's slightly open, friendlier beak and smooth feather layers match the real cards marginally better than A's flatter expression.
